summary: Iteration 7 — Staff login reparto→nome→password picker. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed on /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7_staff_directory.py — GET /api/staff/directory works with NO auth header, returns {departments:[{id,label,color,members:[{name,email}]}]}, department counts match spec (direzione 1, camerieri≥11, cassieri 5, cambusa 1, barman 1, runner 1), members sorted alphabetically, no password_hash / _id / user_id leak, JWT login still works for direzione@glitz.staff (glitzadmin2026), mara.lagatta@glitz.staff (glitz2026), christian.giuseppe.pisciotta@glitz.staff (glitz2026), wrong password returns 401, /api/staff/me reports is_direzione:true for direzione, fresh guest registers → role != staff → /api/staff/board returns 403. Frontend on 390x844 mobile viewport: (T1) welcome → go-staff → staff-login-screen → dept-direzione → member-direzione@glitz.staff → staff-password 'glitzadmin2026' → staff-login-submit → staff-board loaded. (T2) dept-camerieri → member-mara.lagatta@glitz.staff → wrong password → staff-login-error is visible and page stays on /staff-login (no navigation). (T3) dept-cambusa → member-christian.giuseppe.pisciotta@glitz.staff → 'glitz2026' → staff-board loaded (URL=/staff). (T4) Regression: fresh guest registered via API, then normal guest email login from the standard login screen lands on the 5 tabs (Home/Eventi/A.I./Ordina/Altro visible); direct navigation to /staff bounces the guest back to / (cannot reach staff-board). No deprecated packages detected. No React Native red screen. Only pre-existing 'shadow*' style-props deprecation warning from RN Web (cosmetic, same as iter 5-6).

issues: Pre-existing 'shadow*' style-props deprecation warning from RN Web (cosmetic, same as iter 5-6).

critical_code_review_comments: backend/staff.py /directory: correctly declared PUBLIC (no Depends(require_staff)), only returns name+email+department, projection {_id:0,name:1,email:1,department:1} — no password_hash leaked. Verified via response body inspection.
backend/staff.py /directory: groups by DEPARTMENTS keys and skips empty departments (`if ms`), so ordering is stable (dict insertion order of DEPARTMENTS).
backend/staff.py /directory: members are sorted by name at query time (`.sort('name', 1)`), which the UI relies on — verified in test_directory_members_sorted.

frontend staff-login.tsx: 3-step picker resets email/name/error when a different reparto is tapped (good UX). The password step gates the submit with `if (!email) return`, preventing an accidental empty-email login attempt.

frontend staff-login.tsx: `useQuery(['staff-directory'])` caches the directory across mounts; the ScrollView inside KeyboardAwareScrollView uses `nestedScrollEnabled` and maxHeight:260 for the member box — works on web preview.

frontend staff-login.tsx: on failed login, error is captured from e?.data?.detail and shown via testID='staff-login-error'; busy is only reset in the catch branch, which is correct since success replaces the screen.
frontend welcome.tsx: 'go-staff' link routes to /(auth)/staff-login as expected.
seed_data_creation: One fresh guest per run (iter7_<hex>@glitz.test and iter7ui_<hex>@glitz.test / secret1) used solely to verify guest role separation and inability to reach /staff. No writes to staff tables.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The staff login uses a 3-step reparto→nome→password picker fed by the public GET /api/staff/directory (no auth). testIDs are: go-staff (welcome), staff-login-screen, dept-<id> (chip), member-<email>, staff-password, staff-login-submit, staff-login-error. Department counts today: direzione 1, camerieri 11 (10 seeded + 1 UI TEST leftover from prior iters — the test allows >=11 for camerieri to tolerate cleanup drift), cassieri 5, cambusa 1, barman 1, runner 1. Guests are correctly bounced off /staff (auth guard sends them back to /).
rca_of_issue: N/A — the reparto-picker fix works end-to-end. All 5 requested checks (backend directory contract, direzione happy path, wrong-password error, cambusa happy path, guest regression) passed with no code changes needed.
